uci.citation: Alberto, T. & Lochter, J. (2015). YouTube Spam Collection. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI: 10.24432/C58885.
uci.modifications: Sampled comments; HTML/contact and URL path/query masking; original labels discarded; AI draft labels added.

user_examples.permission: Project owner explicitly requested Git publication for team testing. No blanket license to the original comments is asserted.

limitations: 22 pilot examples, not a representative evaluation set.
AI labels are unreviewed opinions, not human gold labels.
Masking can remove context. AI reasons are retained without editorial correction.
English-dominant older UCI comments and two selected Korean false-positive reports.
